title: Cornwall, 1705: The Flooded Mine

player.status: A newcomer of modest means. No trade, no guild membership, no local reputation.
skills: Whatever you actually know from the 21st century, and only that

threads: Wheal Fortune's shareholders offer £250 to anyone who keeps the water below 55 m for a month, plus £60 a year for as long as it keeps working.
You have a letter of introduction to Nicholas Penrose, the mine's treasurer.
Jacca Pascoe's wages, 45p, are due every Saturday.
The smithy's rent is paid until 24 June; the next quarter costs £1.50.
